 Prayer: Writ Miscellaneous Petition filed under Article 226 of  Constitution of India to condone the delay of 417 days in filing the  review application against the order passed by this Court in W.P.No.
 of 2018 dated 12.01.2023.
For Petitioners : Mr.M.Suresh Kumar  Additional Advocate General  assisted by Mr.E.Sundaram  Government Advocate  For Respondent : Mr.E.Sathiyaraj  ORDER
In the present petition, the petitioners seek for condonation of 417 days of delay in filing the Review Application.
2.There is absolutely not a single averment made in the affidavit filed in support of the present miscellaneous petition to condone the delay in preferring the Review Application.
A perusal of the affidavit filed in support of the Review Application reveals that none of the ground raised by the review applicants reflect any error apparent on the face of the record.
On the other hand, the grounds address the merits of the case, which cannot be adjudicated in a Review Application.
( Uploaded on: 28/08/2025 01:21:39 pm ) in Rev.Aplw.SR.No.71464 of 2024 3.
Accordingly, the Civil Miscellaneous Petition stands dismissed.
Consequently, the Review Application stands rejected at the SR stage itself.
